articles.author: Helport AI Ltd
articles.headline: Helport AI Advances Transition to Autonomous AI Labor in Southeast Asian Fintech Market
articles.summary: Helport describes expanding autonomous debt-collection systems within an existing Southeast Asian fintech relationship. Deployment of about 300 AI workforce units by the end of November is a target for one customer, subject to customer needs and readiness, rather than a binding new order.
articles.timestampEvidence: The original distributor header gives November 3 at 17:36 ET. Indexed Yahoo syndication explicitly identifies EST. Finviz reproduces the release at the same clock time.

limitations: Partial review of the exact listed entries only; other entries and older sessions remain unreviewed.
Direct Yahoo quote/news requests returned HTTP 429. Indexed syndications were used where available, and publication clocks were not inferred from URLs or relative ages.
Search and public quote-page archives are incomplete. No finding establishes exhaustive coverage, a price catalyst or the version of an article served before entry.
The November 3 issuer release precedes the November 4 entry. Its workforce deployment figures are targets, not guaranteed orders. Intraday November 4 reports published after the entry were excluded.
reviews.scope: Recent-session backfill: exact first entries on November 2-5, 2026. Confirmed timestamps use the preceding 48 elapsed hours; only genuinely unknown clocks or zones may use the previous two New York calendar dates.
